title: Text Generation

import { Tabs, TabItem } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

Text generation is the core capability of the Peaking AI platform. Use the Chat Completions API to generate text for any use case — from creative writing to structured data extraction.

## Basic usage

```python
from peaking import PeakingAI

client = PeakingAI()

response = client.chat.create(
    model="peak-1",
    messages=[
        {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."},
        {"role": "user", "content": "Write a product description for wireless headphones."}
    ]
)
```

## Multi-turn conversations

Maintain context by passing the full message history:

```python
messages = [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "What is photosynthesis?"},
    {"role": "assistant", "content": "Photosynthesis is the process by which plants..."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "How does it relate to cellular respiration?"}
]

response = client.chat.create(model="peak-1", messages=messages)
```

## System prompts

System prompts set the behavior and persona of the model:

```python
response = client.chat.create(
    model="peak-1",
    messages=[
        {
            "role": "system",
            "content": "You are a senior software engineer. Respond with concise, "
                       "production-ready code. Include error handling. No explanations "
                       "unless asked."
        },
        {"role": "user", "content": "Write a rate limiter in Python."}
    ]
)
```

## Structured outputs

Force the model to return JSON matching a schema:

```python
response = client.chat.create(
    model="peak-1",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Extract entities from: 'John works at Acme Corp in NYC'"}],
    response_format={
        "type": "json_schema",
        "json_schema": {
            "name": "entities",
            "schema": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                    "people": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}},
                    "organizations": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}},
                    "locations": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}
                },
                "required": ["people", "organizations", "locations"]
            }
        }
    }
)
```

:::tip
Structured outputs guarantee valid JSON conforming to your schema. Use them for data extraction, form filling, and any pipeline where downstream code parses the response.
:::

## Temperature and sampling

Control the randomness and creativity of outputs:

| Temperature | Use case |
|------------|----------|
| 0.0 | Deterministic tasks: classification, extraction, code |
| 0.3 - 0.7 | Balanced: summarization, Q&A, analysis |
| 0.8 - 1.0 | Creative: storytelling, brainstorming, marketing copy |
